concerns.text: Task T007 is marked `[P]` but writes to a shared state file (`state/projects/PROJ‑474‑neural‑correlates‑social‑ex.yaml`). Parallel execution of any `[P]` tasks that invoke `code/integrity.py` could cause race conditions and corrupt the artifact hash registry.

Task T014 is marked `[P]` yet calls `code/integrity.py` after writing each subject’s cleaned image. Because `integrity.py` updates the same global YAML state, running T014 in parallel across subjects is not safe.
